# PLLM

Release: 0.1.0
Build: sha256:358faf6bdfe0705a92c0f87f5cdd73fcee9a6ff7cd651f912f232815241ebaf7

Private LLM inference documentation. Public weights; provider follows the protocol.

- [Operate](https://pllm.run/sdk/operate/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/operate.md)): Assign client, preparation, and inference responsibilities without weakening the privacy design.
- [Client boundary](https://pllm.run/sdk/operate/client-boundary/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/operate/client-boundary.md)): Understand which data and runtime state must stay with the client.
- [Provider roles](https://pllm.run/sdk/operate/provider-roles/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/operate/provider-roles.md)): Understand the responsibilities of deployment operators, preparation services, and inference services.
- [Deployment](https://pllm.run/sdk/operate/deployment/status/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/operate/deployment/status.md)): Understand current deployment support, required role placement, and missing orchestration.
- [Compiler](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/compiler/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/compiler.md)): Learn how PLLM turns a model plan and component choices into a checked execution plan.
- [Deployment](https://pllm.run/sdk/operate/deployment/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/operate/deployment.md)): Learn how to assign PLLM roles to authenticated services without changing privacy assumptions.
- [Kernels](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/kernels/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/kernels.md)): Understand PLLM's native integer matrix kernels, memory costs, and CPU requirements.
- [Pipeline](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline.md)): Combine model, privacy protocol, preparation, runtime, and deployment choices in one configuration.
- [Preparation](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/preparation/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/preparation.md)): Prepare one-time masked material before a private inference request starts.
- [Runtime](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/runtime/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/runtime.md)): Understand which live state a PLLM runtime owns and how it differs from a reproducible plan.
